t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It feel like the advice used a lot of unnecessary filler just to increase the word count. Regardless, I feel like the advice could have been given in just one paragraph.

vb_textbox.text: I wish I could give you some advice that will help you to achieve a higher score, but over the course of the game, I tried my best to figure out if there was a pattern being used or anything that could assist me in getting better x5 picks but I couldn't.What I can tell you, is that some colours go to a forest with light trees (Orange, Red, Green and Blue) where the others take you to a dark forest. These forests and the number of mushrooms in them are totally random and follow no pattern I could discern. Good luck
